value.notes: Orange County Power Authority (OCPA), the only CCA operating in Orange County, directly re-verified this session via its own homepage's 'Celebrating our member communities' listing as serving exactly four member cities: Buena Park, Fullerton, Irvine, and Fountain Valley. Laguna Beach is not among them, so Southern California Edison (SCE) is recorded as both the distribution and generation utility.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Laguna Beach/Orange County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

required_documents.notes: lagunabeachcity.net returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch on every attempt this session, blocking access to any solar-specific submittal requirements.

value: Request inspections by emailing lbinspectors@lagunabeachcity.net before 4:00pm to receive an inspection the following business day (no same-day inspections); provide project address, permit number(s), inspection type(s), request date, and requestor name/mobile number
Confirm the inspection date/time via the city's Daily Inspections page or by calling (949) 497-0715 on the morning of the inspection after 8:30am; no confirmation call is placed to the requestor
Permits expire if inspections are not scheduled and passed every 180 days; a final 'passed' inspection is required to complete the permit
inspection_steps.notes: This is the City's general Building Division inspection process (the same page covers all building permit types, including solar); the City does not publish a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.
